terrainDescription.zh: 地勢極為平坦，大片國土低於海平面，仰賴堤防與圩田排水系統，西部蘭斯台德都會區高度都市化。
terrainDescription.en: Exceptionally flat, with large areas below sea level held back by dikes and polder drainage systems; the western Randstad conurbation is intensely urbanized.

plate.color: yellow background, black text, blue EU band with "NL" (mandatory since 2000; pre-1977 vehicles may retain white-on-blue)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Simple white bollard with a red reflector; round French-style bollards (red band, pointed top) occasionally appear too

utilityPole.transformerMount: Utility poles are largely absent in most of the Netherlands (undergrounded cabling) — their near-total absence is itself a distinguishing clue rather than a specific pole style

historicalContext.zh: 荷蘭語為日耳曼語族，與比利時北部法蘭德斯地區的荷語（Flemish）高度相通；A 級高速公路標誌上的道路編號固定放在紅色方框中，是辨識度很高的路牌特徵。
historicalContext.en: Dutch is a Germanic language closely related to Flemish spoken in northern Belgium; A-road motorway signs place the route number in a distinctive red box, a highly recognizable signage trait.
